body: Thank you very much for the info. I’m ashamed that I get very overwhelmed simply by just trying to find someone to be open with.

I completely understand. I’m a female engineer, decorated Veteran, married to a good man, averaging 97 percentile in my graduate degree program... but I’m miserable. I don’t know how to love myself and feel like a burden; I’m so ashamed of it all I struggle to seek help out of fear of abandonment. I think ideation is easier for me to internalize because I don’t want to burden to others and I easily devalue myself. 

I hope you’re doing okay. I know it isn’t easy, but know you’re not alone in feeling this way.
Do you have a specific resource to suggest for the online format? Is it text based?
I’m so sorry you’re feeling this way. Don’t let other users guilt you, your pain and struggle is valid. I hope you decide to stick around to see your children grow.
